item.title: Monday 1 PM Update, Oct 19
item.description:
The Monday one o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 19, 2026: a federal sweep of alleged noncitizen voters in California, the Supreme Court turning away the 9/11 plea-deal appeals and taking up the home-distilling ban, and the signing of the women's health executive order; France's first curfews and a blockaded Louvre, the rising toll from a Houthi strike in Yemen, Iran's claim of a U.S. strike on a naval base, and deep food-aid cuts in Gaza; a midday market rebound led by chips, with homebuilder confidence at a 14-year low; Nvidia winning Modal for its new CPUs and a shake-up at Netflix; Washington ordering DeepSeek off federal systems; a hacker who let AI agents break into more than 100 company websites, and new allegations against an ex-OpenAI engineer; your X feed with Jalen Hurts, Christiane Amanpour and a council of Claudes; Londonderry's water-line progress and tonight's council meeting; and a 99-year-old wing walker. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Monday 10 AM Update, Oct 19

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Monday Morning, Oct 19
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Sunday 4 PM Update, Oct 18
item.description:
The Sunday four o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for October 18, 2026: two killed when a pickup drove onto a youth soccer field in Wichita, an airman killed in a rappelling fall at the Alamodome, early voting opening in Texas, President Macron's address as cost-of-living unrest spreads to Milan and Lisbon, Iran restating its Hormuz offer, an MIT model that lets A.I. see crystals in 3D, Anthropic's new Public Benefit Fund, OpenCode's defenders getting refusals from the A.I. they used to fight back, your X feed with Taylor Swift's fifteenth week at number one and the weekend box office, the Patriots and New England's newest pro football team, and LouLou, the dog an AirTag helped find after an Alaska avalanche. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
